image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a slice of meatloaf served on a white plate with a silver rim. The meatloaf slice has a textured, browned crust and a lighter, dense interior visible at the cut edge. It is topped with a glossy, dark reddish-brown glaze that appears to be tomato-based, with some pooling around the base. A fork rests on the plate behind the meatloaf, partially out of focus. The lighting is warm, suggesting an indoor dining setting.

The fork in the background exhibits significant depth-of-field blur. While this can be photographic, the transition edges show slight softness typical of AI generation focusing on the main subject.

To assess the realism of the food textures, specifically the glaze viscosity and meat crumb structure.
To ensure the slice is a coherent object without melting edges or strange separations between the crust and interior.
